name: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
label: Quest
description: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle marks the collection of a mysterious package held on your behalf. Left behind by an unidentified messenger…
intro: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle marks the collection of a mysterious package held on your behalf. Left behind by an unidentified messenger, the parcel was narrowly saved from being dumped into the sea before reaching your hands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wait, wait, you said your name was friend?

Friend! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!
Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.
What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
